items.source_text: 彩 Phantasia
items.current_text: 彩 Phantasia

community_terms.basis: Official Lantis WINNING LIVE 02 identifies 彩 Phantasia as a named Uma Musume song. Established English-facing Uma Musume discography references romanize the title as Irodori Phantasia. Preserve that stable Latin/Romanized proper-name identity instead of the semantic Vietnamese calque. Exact matching prevents the generic character 彩 from being canonicalized in unrelated prose.
